title: Horizon
excerpt: A dashboard that reads markets, news and geopolitics for me and shows only the few things that actually matter.

data.text: The idea is the opposite of a feed: a dashboard that every day reads markets, crypto, news, weather and geopolitics, gives each signal a relevance score and shows me ten at most.
An LLM classifies, groups by topic and drops the noise; I only read what clears the threshold. It is related to Flux: there I read what I choose, here something chooses for me what is worth knowing.

image_captions: Horizon dashboard with HeroStatus, QuickStats and DataStream filtered by relevance
